column1: # Every route Infisical v0.167.6 registers that refuses a person's session by its kind, read by asking each registered route with the admin's
# own session on a throwaway copy of this version: verifyAuth answered 403 Forbidden access to it. So each takes only a machine's credential,
# and no browser calls it. tests/routes/infisical-public-route.py asks each through the public route, and each must not reach the server.
